dataList.content:
Answer me now! What is it that thou claimest that I have?
那么回答吾，吾到底拥有什么？

What weight did my name carry?! Speak!!
此名所承之重到底为何！！

Where— How— Where didst thou...
汝等究竟是从何处把吾……

... Everything. Everything that we Bloodfiends of this Area desire.
……那是这个区域的血魔们都渴望着的。

To exist in ignorance of the truth that we are but going in circles, not marching toward what lies ahead...
为了忘记……我们……并非在向前，而是一直在同一个地方循环的事实……

Something that we all desire but own not, yet you have...
这一区域的每个人都渴望，却只有你拥有的东西……

Oblivion.
忘却。

That which all who are lost in this Area yearn so desperately for.
这是彷徨于这一区域的人们所迫切希望的。

The privilege to flee from everything. From desires, from shame.
是逃避欲望与羞耻的权利。

The gift of oblivion, the innocence, the naïveté to endure and live through another day.
如果能够忘却的话，即便辛苦也能够一天天地坚持下去吧。

No, not again...!
妈的，又来了……

I thought it was about time you missed me.
我以为到了这种时候，你会想念我的。

It is high time you regaled us with that particular tale, isn't it?
是时候给我们讲讲那个故事了。

Tell us how that grand adventure, for which you abandoned us all, ended.
那个你弃我们而去的、伟大冒险的结局。

What...?
什么……

Galloping on, and on...
哒哒哒、哒哒哒。

As always, Rocinante was merrily and energetically galloping on with you upon its saddle...
你像往常一样，骑着驽骍难得欢快而充满活力地奔跑着……

... Come on... just die!
……求你……去死吧！

Hngh...
呃……

... while leaving us to slowly expire in a most painful death. Just like this poor soul.
像这样，将悲惨地死去的人抛在身后。

... Enough.
……停下。

Please... Enough...
请停下吧……

Thy strength must surpass mine; thus bound I have become by thy sorcery. Yes...
吾动弹不得是因比汝无力吧。是啊……

So please, I must beseech thee so. I have no choice but to beg, for I cannot turn my tongue into a sharp spear to skewer thee...!
因而吾必须如此恳求汝。若能将舌化为矛尖，吾当立刻向汝刺去，可却连此也力不能及……！

I will pray unto thee, cower and grovel before thee... to cease this wickedness!
吾卑微地……恳求汝……停止汝之恶行！

Well, why stop now? Don't you just love sharing the stories of your adventures with everyone? Isn't this exactly what you have always wished for?
为什么呢，你不是比谁都更渴望向大家讲述你的冒险故事吗？

You have such a captive audience before you, listening to your tale more intently than ever. You won't get another opportunity like this.
能慎重……且深入地倾听你的故事的观众举目皆是。哪里还有这样的机会？

... I don't want to. Not anymore.
……吾现在不想讲了。

But you will.
不。

You will share your tale.
你会讲述你的故事。

For that is your role in this play.
因为那就是你的职责。

Thus you, Rocinante, and the Knight of the White Moon embark on your final adventure. Or, perhaps, it would be more accurate to say that... you fled.
你与驽骍难得和白月骑士一起，踏上了最后的冒险之旅。准确来说，是避难之旅。

dataList.content:
We saw so many rivers on our way here, didn't we?
我们在来这里的路上看到了许多条河，对吧？

All these rivers... were beneath the City all along?
在都市下面……竟然有这种河流存在。

It is said that when an efflorescent tree comes to blossom, steeped and nurtured in the waters of many rivers since its saplinghood, it becomes imbued with a special power.
由众多河流之水所滋养的花，据说能够长出这种花的树，具有特别的力量。

I can't even begin to imagine what powers a tree born from that particular river may hold.
我无法想象由那河水所孕育出来的树木能拥有什么样的能力。

Pray tell, what river is it that we seek?
请告知吾，吾等在探寻怎样的河流？

Well, none of the rivers we've walked by is the one we're looking for.
我们经过的这些河中，还没有我们要找的那条。

... Not this one either, then?
……也不是这条河吗？

Regrettably, no. Perhaps we should seek a river that flows even deeper into the abyss.
没错。很遗憾也不是这里。或许我们需要找到一条延伸至更深处的河流。

The depths of the Ruins are certainly dangerous, even for someone who's ventured down here in the past. It's giving even you a run for your money, isn't it?
即使对来过一次的人来说，前往废墟的深处也很困难。对你来说也并不容易吧？

... What river is this...?
……这条河是……？

Whoever drinks the waters of this river shall be granted a vision of... a certain future. It brings the drinker visions of what is to come, yet blinds them to all things save for those of the future, driving them to insanity.
这是一条能够将某个未来展现给你的河流。据说只要喝下这河水就能够看到未来，但最后会变得只知道看着未来而陷入癫狂。

And to the drinker, only a singular future remains: a vision of their own madness.
最终他们所看到的未来只有发狂的自己。

I call this the 'Mirae-mirae River'... or the River of Future-future. It must've had a name once, but this is the name I gave it.
我将其称为“未来未来河”。可能原本有别的名字，但我就是那样叫的。

Quite the irony, then.
真讽刺啊。

Though it won't show you the exact moment you wish to see, you may look into the river to catch a glimpse of a certain moment in the future. It may be quite disorienting, but... would you like to try anyway?
虽然看不到所期望的瞬间……但透过水面的倒影，可以看到某一瞬的未来。可能有点难以理解，不过要不要看一下试试？

I ill wish to be so close to the waters, but... I shall.
吾不想过于靠近水边，但……吾会去的。

What do you see?
你看到了什么？

Chains... a great gate... and... a timepiece... A flaming timepiece...? And... a promise...
锁链……巨大的门……还有……那是时钟吗……燃烧的时钟……？还有约定……

It is as you have said. Visions I have seen, yet I fail to see the sense in each of them.
就像汝所说的，即便观看也不知所见为何物。

Right. You won't ever get a clear picture unless you drink the waters yourself.
如果不饮用这里的水，你就很难知晓明确的未来。

Still, if you've seen that clock... and the visions of promise...? Hm. Perhaps this has something to do with that promise you made with him.
即便如此，你在河水中看到了那时钟……以及约定的话……可能是与和那个人的某个约定有关的时钟。

The promised timepiece, is it...?
是约定的时钟吗……

After suffering through brutal trials upon trials, you arrive at the place you have been searching so hard for.
长年努力之后，你终于到达了你想去的地方。

And here, we return to the very first chapter of this tale.
这里回到了故事的第一章。

This is...?
这里是……

The River of Oblivion.
忘却之河。

Lethe...
勒忒……

dataList.content:
Thus spake the Knight of the White Moon.
白月骑士如是说。

Are you certain?
真的吗？

Drink from this well, and the life you have lived thus far will be no more.
喝下这口井的水，就会抹去你全部的人生。

All of it, gone in a sip.
只要喝上一口，一切就都结束了。

You reflexively gulp.
你咽了口唾沫。

I have... decided.
吾……决定了。

Will you answer me, were I to ask you why?
如果我问你的话，你会告诉我理由吗？

I see it still, past the darkness of my eyelids.
即便闭上双眼，吾仍能见到。

I see a vision of that day. The screaming and shouting, the stench of blood, the...
那日之叫喊声，那日之血腥味，那日之……

The more I recall, the more I find myself cracking and crumbling like a castle of sand.
复苏的记忆越多，吾就越为崩溃。

Thus I wish to forget everything that's happened and crawl into a deep slumber.
因此吾才想忘记一切，陷入深眠。

Because while I sleep, there will be no fear, no hope, no suffering, and no glory.
在那深眠之中，没有恐惧，没有希望，没有苦痛，亦没有荣光。

But there is an unsavory part to sleep, isn't there? It's...
但睡眠有一个缺点。那就是……

Yes. It is much like death. Yet it distinguishes itself in ways that matter.
是的，和死去很相似。但此二者之间有关键的地方不同，不是吗？

You want to dream.
你想做梦啊。

For those mere words which made us leave everything behind, only to shackle us in the end... I long to continue the dream I have been but a mere witness to.
为了那些让吾等抛弃一切，已然化为脚镣的话语，吾想继续去见证那个梦。

Then...
那么。

... I have no other way to help you, do I?
我能帮到你的办法就只有这一种了。

The name of this companion...
如此说道的这个人名为……

Then... before oblivion takes my name away from you, allow me to introduce myself one last time.
最后……我再介绍一下即将被忘记的我的名字。

I am the flower-seeker, a wanderer, a traveler across the City and the Ruins.
我是彷徨于都市与废墟之中，探寻花朵的旅行者。

I am the one who marked the final period to this unforgotten adventure of a lifetime with you.
也是现在和你一起为你一生难忘的冒险画上句号的人。

My name is Bari, the Knight of the White Moon.
白月骑士，巴里。

I will now leave, and return to my search for the river and the flower born from its waters. As I always have.
现在我将继续去寻找我一直在寻找的那条河流，以及蕴含着其河水而绽放的花朵，一如既往。

... Even should I drink the waters of this river... will you tell me the tales of Fixers still?
那在我饮下这条河的水之后……你还会给我讲收尾人的故事吗？

... I may pass by this area quite often through my journey.
……在旅途中我或许还会再经过这里几次。

Every chance I get, I'll leave a book or an item behind. Things that may be of help to you.
每当那时，我都会静静地在你身边留下能够提醒你的书或物品。

... Thank you.
……谢谢。

Thus, you lean over the river to drink its water.
最终你俯下身去喝那条河里的水。

However valiant a knight Don Quixote was, she cannot help but shudder from an overwhelming sense of terror and omen.
即便是勇敢的骑士堂吉诃德，她的身体也因为不祥的预感开始发抖。

I... no. I cannot have let such fear touch me. I, who have written such tales of brave adventures...
吾……写下了勇敢冒险的记录的吾不会发抖。

Well, every tale needs a rising action and a climax, doesn't it? It's the ups and downs that keeps things interesting.
故事要跌宕起伏才有乐趣。

Hgh, nngh...!
呃、呃呃……

Sansón ignores Don Quixote's struggles and rapidly continues the tale, like he was incanting a spell.
参孙无视了正在挣扎的堂吉诃德，像念咒语一样快速地说了下去。

Our common, primeval fear of the flowing water. Your body shudders, horripilation of the skin spreading through every inch of your being as your psyche, your consciousness itself, furiously refuses to approach its undulating surface. Our blood, thicker than water, cycles through your system with inhuman rapidity as your heart begins to race like that of a rabid animal.
流动的水会带给我们本能的恐惧。全身开始起鸡皮疙瘩，意识开始猛烈地抗拒。我们那比水更浓的血开始迅速流动，你的心脏也开始疯狂跳动。

Yet, you must conquer that fear. You had to.
即便如此你也必须克服那恐惧。

Moments before you take a sip of that river's water, a thought flickers through your mind. That to continue this adventure was meaningless.
在喝下河水之前，你曾想过。继续这场冒险已经没有意义了。

That is how you dismount Rocinante.
这就是你为何从驽骍难得上下来。

Rocinante, only borrowed from its original master.
驽骍难得只是从它原来的主人那里暂时借来的。

Don Quixote looks down toward Rocinante.
堂吉诃德低下头看着自己的驽骍难得。

I... at least Faust and I know what Sansón's incantation is attempting to accomplish.
我……至少我和浮士德清楚地知道，参孙的咒语蕴含着什么意义。

He's trying to draw out her memories from the River of Oblivion...
他在试图从忘却之河里……打捞起她的记忆。

<Don Quixote! No, don't...!>
<堂吉诃德，不行……不可以……>

<Faust! Do someth—>
<浮士德！做点什……>

... Nothing can be done.
……无计可施。

This flow is destined to be.
这一流向已成定局。

What... what's goin' on? You two look bloody serious all of a sudden.
什……发生了什么？你们突然看起来很严肃。

Wait. If we connect all these tales into one, then...
如果把所有我们之前听到的故事连在一起……

No way, is she...?
难道……

... No. That's impossible.
……不，那不可能。

Don Quixote's spine slowly bends forward.
慢慢地……堂吉诃德弯下了腰。

This cannot be stopped. She does not try to stop it, either. Don Quixote moves as though she was destined to, as though this was all but her part in the play.
停不下来。也没有想过停下。也许堂吉诃德的宿命，就是在这故事中像这样行动。

For a moment, she appears tranquil, even brave. Like a knight briefly dismounting from a beloved steed.
她仿佛只是暂时……从自己的爱马上下来而已，看起来平静而毅然。

Yet once she dismounts, once the repressed memories return...
但从马上下来，复苏那已沉没的记忆的话。

The Sinners will come face-to-face with the red glow of her eyes and the metallic stench of blood that surrounds her.
全体罪人就将直面那双眼血红，散发血腥气的堂吉诃德……

Once the truth comes out, we... the Sinners... will never be able to see her in the same light again.
他们之间的关系就再也无法回到原来的样子了。

Dante...?
但丁……？

... This must have aught to do with her ragged running shoes...
……她那双旧运动鞋似乎有什么……

What I've been fearing ever since the incident at the WARP train, the fear that has been madly scratching at the back of my mind...
……从WARP列车上离开以来，就一直在令我苦恼的，也是我最想避开的……

The fear that the bond between the Sinners will be irrevocably broken.
罪人们的关系支离破碎的瞬间还是到来了吗。

Will everyone be accepting of this deception, accidental though it may have been?
就算她并非出于故意，大家就能够原谅她吗？

Even if we were to survive, will she return to how she once was, as one of us Sinners?
她还能变回曾是同伴的那位罪人吗？

How will I appear in their eyes? I, who knowingly hid the truth from them? Can I truly face this Don Quixote, when I trembled from so much fear the last time?
明明知晓事实却隐瞒的我，会被他们怎么看待呢？看着改变模样的堂吉诃德而恐惧到浑身颤抖的我，还能真切地面对她吗？

As if to render all these raging thoughts in my head void...
所有的担心与后悔都没有意义。

Don Quixote takes off Rocinante...
堂吉诃德缓缓脱下了驽骍难得。

and lets her bare feet touch the cold earth.
使她赤裸的双足与冰冷的地面相触。

All of a sudden, visions of Don Quixote's past begins flooding into me, raw and unfiltered.
此时，堂吉诃德不经任何干涉与加工的过去，才第一次展现在我的面前。
